# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are applied to the current `master` branch and, when applicable,
the latest published release. Development and feature branches are not
supported release lines.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not report a suspected vulnerability in a public issue, discussion, or pull
request. Use
[GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/cookscodeinc/cookie-factory/security/advisories/new)
or email
[Cook's Code, Inc.](mailto:cookscodeinc+github@gmail.com?subject=Cookie%20Factory%20security%20report).

Include the affected component and version, reproduction steps, impact, and any
suggested mitigation. Avoid including sensitive production data. You should
receive an acknowledgement within five business days, followed by status
updates while the report is investigated.

Please allow reasonable time for a fix and coordinated disclosure. Confirmed
issues will be documented with a GitHub Security Advisory when appropriate.

Vulnerabilities in a generated project or an upstream Cookiecutter should be
reported to that project's owner unless Cookie Factory introduced the issue.
